assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE transparent cutout inventory gemstone icon for an original dark western fantasy RPG, intended to remain clear at 40 to 64 pixels. Hand-painted 2D game item illustration, crisp exaggerated LARGE facet planes, deep colored lower side planes, subtle brush texture, restrained warm white highlights at the upper left, rich luminous stone body but not neon. Strong silhouette and readable value contrast, a slight three-quarter tilt giving volume. No photorealistic macro photography, no jewelry advertising, no transparent glass blandness, no flat vector look. Gem itself fills about 76 percent of a square canvas with empty transparent margins on all sides. No setting, no frame or border, no text or runes, no pedestal, no background, no huge halo, no secondary objects. One object only, actual transparent alpha. Subject: elongated marquise / flame-teardrop ruby, pointed at both ends, rich garnet red, a strong narrow pointed silhouette.
